result.summary: The home screen of a food delivery app is mostly well laid out. One clear visual defect: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a broken-image placeholder instead of a photo. Minor issues with the overlapping time badge and low-contrast secondary text were also noted.

issues.description: The hero image for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' list failed to load. A gray box with a broken-image icon is shown instead of a food photo, while neighboring cards (pizza, burger) display images correctly. This makes the card look broken and less appealing.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL or loading logic, add retry handling, and provide a branded fallback placeholder or skeleton instead of the default broken-image icon.

issues.description: On the 'Green Bowl Poké' card, the '15–25 min' badge overlaps and appears to collide with the bowl image, and its left inset looks inconsistent with the other cards' badges (which sit further from the plate). The badge position seems slightly off.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent badge anchor (fixed left/bottom padding) across all cards, and make sure it does not cover key parts of the image.

issues.description: Secondary text such as the delivery fee lines ('€0.90 delivery') and the meta line under the restaurant name ('25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen') is light gray on white, with low contrast. The search placeholder is similarly faint.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1).
